title: MCX jumps 5% as gold and silver rebound

timeline.title: MCX jumps 5% as gold and silver rebound
timeline.line: MCX rose as much as 5% to about ₹3,757 on a rebound in gold and silver prices
more: MarketsMojo calls it a fresh all-time high of ₹3,759
Other reports put the record at ₹3,774 on 18 Nov; sources differ
The stock is up about 70% so far in 2026

src.title: MCX Shares Surge 5% as Gold and Silver Prices Bounce Back
